items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: At Alcune Theatre, when Emil Tosso all started, what was his name? Boco? Not Boco, no. Russo. Joe Russo. That's what his daddy said.

ctx.x: Well, I could play pretty. But he's a fast man. I'm a good girl.

At Alcune Theatre, when Emil Tosso all started, what was his name? Boco? Not Boco, no. Russo. Joe Russo. That's what his daddy said. It was Alcune Theatre. You mean Jack and Sonja used to play? Old man, yeah. Yeah.
